Showcase.title: Design System Showcase
Showcase.description: shadcn/ui components with full RTL and LTR support.

Foundations.title: Foundations
Foundations.description: The visual primitives used to keep components and product surfaces consistent across the application.

Colors.title: Color tokens
Colors.description: Semantic colors are used instead of hard-coded palette values. Switch the theme to verify both modes.

borders.title: Borders
borders.description: Border strength communicates hierarchy without relying on decorative shadows.

destructive.title: Destructive border
destructive.description: Reserved for dangerous or destructive states.

Typography.title: Typography
Typography.description: A restrained type scale with clear separation between display text, headings, body copy and metadata.

body.label: Body
body.sample: The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog.

Surfaces.title: Surfaces and radius
Surfaces.description: Containers rely primarily on background contrast, borders and consistent corner radii.

mutedSurface.title: Muted surface
mutedSurface.description: Use muted backgrounds to group secondary information without creating unnecessary cards.

spacing.title: Spacing rhythm
spacing.description: A consistent spacing scale keeps layout density and visual relationships predictable.

Buttons.title: Buttons
Buttons.variantsDesc: Icons take their position from the reading direction, with no language-specific condition.

sizes.title: Sizes
sizes.description: Button dimensions should reflect action hierarchy rather than decoration.

Dialogs.title: Dialogs
Dialogs.headerDesc: Make changes to your profile here, then save when you're done.
Dialogs.showcaseDescription: Open the dialog to review overlay behavior, fields, spacing and action hierarchy.

Inputs.title: Inputs
Inputs.description: Input fields shown with practical content, disabled states and bidirectional values.

composition.title: Field composition
composition.label: Account email
composition.helper: Helper text explains requirements without competing with the field label.

Cards.title: Cards
Cards.description: Cards are used for self-contained content. Avoid wrapping every section in a card.

standard.title: Standard card
standard.description: Primary content with a clear title and supporting copy.
standard.content: Card content inherits the application's semantic colors and adapts automatically between themes.

secondary.title: Secondary card
secondary.description: A quieter presentation for secondary information.

Internationalization.title: Internationalization
Internationalization.description: Direction, locale and mixed-content behavior are part of the design system rather than implementation details.

Formatting.title: Formatting
Formatting.description: Dates, numbers and currencies are formatted through Intl per locale — never written by hand.
